MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The snap ring assortment fits my habit of keeping fasteners available for mechanical repairs, much like my cotter pins, rivet nuts, and bolt assortments.",
    "Quick-bond glue and wire connectors offer practical ways to complete repairs alongside the adhesives and fastening supplies I already use.",
    "Wire brushes fit the surface preparation work that goes with cutting, drilling, and assembling metal, provided they fit my grinder."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Breadboards and extra multimeter probes assume an electronics project that my recent purchases do not establish; repairing wiring does not mean I am building circuits or testing electronics.",
    "The wireless temperature sensor serves ongoing monitoring, while my thermometer purchase was about taking spot measurements during practical tasks.",
    "The hydraulic cap and plug kit requires a specific kind of equipment repair that my general fastening and fabrication supplies do not imply."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having workshop tools seems to have been treated as interest in almost any technical equipment, even when it serves a different job.",
    "A shared brand or a broad connection to measurement is not enough: my grommet press does not establish hydraulic work, and my thermometer does not establish a need for continuous monitoring."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of assorted fasteners suggest that versatile supplies for mechanical assembly and repairs are especially useful to me.",
    "Project requirements matter before I choose equipment: the aluminum rails appeal to me, but I need to know the required lengths and fittings first.",
    "Interest does not always mean readiness to buy; wire brushes need compatible equipment, and storage panels need suitable capacity and wall space."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in practical workshop repairs but stretched it too far into electronics, continuous monitoring, and specialized hydraulic work."
}
